newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris says French pilgrims safe from Saudi blaze.
newsitem.headline: Paris says French pilgrims safe from Saudi blaze.

text.p: France sent condolences to Saudi King Fahd on Wednesday over a killer blaze that swept through a Moslem pilgrims camp near Mecca, and said there were no casualties among the many French pilgrims.
The Foreign Ministry said several thousand French nationals were attending the haj and none of them had been registered among the casualties being treated in hospital.
The blaze killed at least 217 and injured nearly 1,300.

"It is with great sadness that I just learned of the tragedy with has struck the Kingdom and the whole of the Moslem community in this sacred time of pilgrimage," French President Jacques Chirac wrote King Fahd.
Chirac sent "very sad condolences" and "deep sympathy" to Fahd and families of the victims.
Most of the victims were reported to be from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh. They were among some two million Moslems from 100 countries gathering for the annual haj pilgrimage.
